reuse.why: Every ranged-amount site (schedule-template, forecast-schedules, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) now calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount with its raw value.

duplication.why: All five inline midpoint/dispatch copies are removed; the missing/number/range decision lives only in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule changes inside shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, which client and server already use for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to how ranged schedules are planned is a single edit in one function that every path uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site computes the amount on its own any more.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client callers.
